note: Handelsbanken's fee information document (30 June 2026): the Allkonto comes in the base offer (the account, a Bankkort Start, internet and mobile banking, Swish) at 25 kronor a month, nothing for customers under 21 (or students 18 to 26 paid by CSN, or holders of its Mastercard, not modelled). Read again 2026-10-30: a payment to another bank's account online costs nothing; one abroad within EU/SEPA online nothing, outside it 60 kronor (written as the transfer abroad; a Nordic customer payment is free); withdrawals at any machine in Sweden nothing; abroad, euros at a machine nothing, another currency 40 kronor plus the 1.65% currency fee, which is also charged on card purchases abroad. Not stated: overdraft, a returned payment, interest, what opening asks.
